**EL-RSP-P4 BCM_ECU lighting handler reaction**

BCM_ECU shall run the BCM_Lighting input handlers within 10 ms of frame reception, also while the turn-signal blink ticker is running.

description: Platform part of EL-RSP-1.2 (BCM_Lighting_IndicatorResponseTime), through ComputeAllocation_BCM_Lighting, which places BCM_Lighting on BCM_ECU.

The handlers are short restbus updates, and ECU_Compute_Budget_Analysis.md keeps the compute needs on BCM_ECU below the 50 MFLOPS it offers, so the 10 ms reaction is a scheduling requirement, not a capacity one.
